# Vendored libraries

Copied unchanged from the npm registry tarballs so the app loads nothing from third-party hosts.

| Library | Version | File | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| [cytoscape](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cytoscape) | 3.29.2 | `cytoscape/cytoscape.min.js` | MIT (`cytoscape/LICENSE`) |
| [dagre](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dagre) | 0.8.5 | `dagre/dagre.min.js` | MIT (`dagre/LICENSE`) |
| [cytoscape-dagre](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cytoscape-dagre) | 2.5.0 | `cytoscape-dagre/cytoscape-dagre.js` | MIT (`cytoscape-dagre/LICENSE`) |

To upgrade: download `https://registry.npmjs.org/<name>/-/<name>-<version>.tgz`, copy the same files, update this table.
